scope.eligible: All 11,044 strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from Aves root V2.
scope.nonApplicable: All 27 strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from Crocodylia root 329 remain package-local non-applicable records and are excluded from AviList match/unmatched counts.

lookup.ordering: Unicode code-unit ascending with no locale folding or normalization.
lookup.requestPolicy: Select the sole package file whose inclusive minColId/maxColId range contains the requested COL ID; load and parse only that payload shard.
lookup.forbiddenBehavior: A single-species detail query must not download or parse the complete AviList sidecar, any upstream-only shard or more than one package payload shard.

futureIntegration.runtimeManifest: Register this descriptor and every checksummed file in the crocodylomorphs-birds rich-package collection without altering the COL species inventory.
futureIntegration.webAndBrowserOffline: The Web client and package/full-atlas offline plans must consume the same descriptor and gzip bytes.
futureIntegration.packageZip: The normal package ZIP must include the descriptor, package colId shards and upstream-only shards unchanged.
futureIntegration.androidAndIos: The complete native release inventory must stage those identical bytes for both Android and iOS; no reduced native subset is permitted.
futureIntegration.releaseBoundary: This data-only change does not edit runtime manifests, release inventories, mobile projects or dataset/app versions.

generatedBy.deterministic: Stable Unicode code-unit ordering, compact JSON arrays and archive-determinism gzip with fixed metadata.

limitations: The crocodylomorphs-birds package count of 11,071 consists of 11,044 Aves plus 27 Crocodylia; 11,071 must not be described as an Aves count.
Exact current-name or protonym agreement is not a species-concept equivalence assertion. Many-to-one mappings, if present, remain visible in the import counts and are never used to merge COL records.
Unmatched and ambiguous COL Aves rows and upstream-only AviList species remain explicit rather than being forced through fuzzy matching.
AvibaseID identifies an AviList taxonomic concept, not a nomenclatural-name record or a phylogenetic node.
